🚨 CVE-2026-86079 - Elastic
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Elastic
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
n8n is an open source workflow automation platform. Prior to 1.123.76, 2.37.7, and 2.38.2, the Elasticsearch and ElasticSecurity nodes interpolated workflow-controlled index and document identifiers directly into REST request paths. An identifier containing path separators or dot segments could select another index or a cluster administration endpoint under the stored Elasticsearch credential. The affected request co...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-86079

Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Docker
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
In the current development version of Eclipse aeriOS, for which no official release has yet been published, the Identity Manager (IdM) deployment included insecure default configurations and credentials for security-sensitive services. The Helm chart exposed the Keycloak service and its PostgreSQL backing database through Kubernetes NodePort services by default, while the Docker Compose deployment similarly exposed P...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-86464
 
🚨 CVE-2026-78545 - Nginx
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Nginx
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 6.6
Resumo:
The Okta Access Gateway does not sanitize the application label field before including it in the generated nginx configuration file. The unsanitized value is interpolated into an nginx server block directive, resulting in execution of injected directives.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-78545
